title: Vitthāro
text: 2. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || Katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || la-pe || paññindriyaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcindriyāni || || 3. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannam indriyānaṃ samattā paripūrattā arahaṃ hoti || tato mudutarehi antarāparinibbāyī- -saddhānusārī hoti || || 4. Iti kho bhikkhave indriyavemattatā phaḷavemattatā hoti || phalavemattatā puggalavemattatā hoti || || [page 202] 202 Indriya-Saṃyuttam XLVIII.
